offering_description.value: Provides active investment management through autonomous investment teams running distinct equity, fixed income and alternative strategies. Serves institutional investors, financial intermediaries and individual investors through pooled funds and separate accounts.

primary_products.value: mutual funds; collective investment trusts; separate account strategies; UCITS funds

primary_services.value: investment management; investment advisory; fund administration and distribution

customer_segment.value: B2B: pension plans, endowments, foundations, sovereign wealth funds, corporations, financial intermediaries and advisors; B2C: individual investors holding mutual funds

end_markets.value: asset management; institutional investing; wealth management; retirement savings

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: management fees based on assets under management, some performance fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: takes in client capital and invests it in securities, serving institutions, intermediaries and individuals

geography_served.value: global: clients in the United States, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: active equity, fixed income and alternative strategies across several investment teams

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: institutional sales team serving pensions, endowments and sovereign investors; partners / resellers: financial intermediaries, wirehouses, RIAs, platforms and sub-advisory relationships

regulatory_exposure.value: high: registered investment adviser regulated by the SEC under the Advisers Act, plus fund rules and foreign regulators such as the FCA
